name: visa_refusal_appeal
description: Decode a France Schengen visa refusal and provide a structured recovery plan. Interprets refusal codes 1-9 (Schengen Visa Code Annex VI), determines whether to reapply or appeal, and produces an action plan with specific documents to strengthen for each cited code. Codes 1, 6, 7 trigger a solicitor referral; codes 2, 3, 4, 8, 9 are handled with document improvements. Applies ETHOS principle #9: refusal is not failure — ~10-15% of first-time applications are refused and most are recoverable.

refusal_code.description: Primary refusal code from the letter (1-9 per Schengen Visa Code Annex VI)

additional_codes.description: Additional refusal codes if multiple were cited

refusal_date.description: Date of the refusal letter (DD Month YYYY or YYYY-MM-DD)

previous_ref.description: France-Visas reference from the refused application

has_previous_approvals.description: Whether the applicant has had any prior Schengen visa approvals

willing_to_reapply.description: Whether the applicant is willing to reapply (as opposed to only pursuing an appeal)
